policy: Do not train all hardening branches together. Each mechanism receives a matched parent and off/on ablation before fusion.

stages.purpose: Measure reshape/trust/relation sensitivity on identical refined layouts.
stages.promotion: Carry only policies that preserve feasibility and jointly improve cost, V_rel, area and b2b.

stages.purpose: Test zero-initialized coordinate blend without changing graph/semantic branches.
stages.control: coordinate parameterization off; all other settings identical
stages.promotion: Joint legalized cost/V_rel gain with unchanged feasibility and legalizer work.

stages.purpose: Add active L1 cluster frames after the envelope-only arm passes.
stages.promotion: Grouping or b2b improvement without area/p2b regression.

stages.purpose: Test deployment-source and short-NFE consistency on the selected coordinate arm.
stages.control: random source and NFE consistency off
stages.promotion: Improved NFE1/NFE4/refiner curves, not only the 2k training loss.

stages.purpose: Add endpoint shape terms independently from graph capacity.
stages.promotion: Area/p2b/rho improvement after legalization with no MIB regression.

stages.purpose: Align training with the exponential official cost without changing model width.
stages.promotion: Improves cost p90/p95 and V_rel p75/p90 without a feasibility regression.

stages.purpose: Test global spec, semantic and dynamic hyperedge only after coordinate/source stability.
stages.promotion: Stable b2b/pin/high-complexity gains under the same legalizer policy.

stages.purpose: Distill M75 candidate states into one model after a larger cohort exists.
stages.promotion: Single fused layout followed by projection and legalization beats the strongest single checkpoint at equal inference.

stages.purpose: Expand block-count coverage without abandoning low-complexity performance.
stages.promotion: High-block tail improves while low-block cost and V_rel remain within the preregistered tolerance.

all_on_config_boundary: configs/chip_sota_architecture_hardening_v1.json is an integration contract, not the first training arm.
